 Mayor Whitmire to announce plans for Houston’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, holiday tree lighting
 Ninfa Saavedra , Digital Content Specialist
 Published:  October 26, 2026 at 9:47 AM Tags:  Mayor Turner , Tree lighting , Thanksgiving Day Parade 70th Annual H-E-B Thanksgiving Day Parade Parade with Grand Marshall Jim McIngvale in downtown Houston, Thursday, November 28, 2019. (Photo by Donna Carson) (DONNA CARSON, Donna Carson) Mayor John Whitmire is set to announce plans for Houston’s annual holiday events Monday, including the H-E-B Thanksgiving Day Parade and the Reliant presents Deck the Hall tree lighting concert.
 Whitmire and event sponsors will share details about the holiday celebrations during a news conference scheduled for 10 a.m. Monday, Oct. 26, at Houston City Hall.
 Recommended Videos
 The H-E-B Thanksgiving Day Parade is an annual Houston tradition held on Thanksgiving morning. Reliant presents Deck the Hall features the annual City Hall tree lighting concert, kicking off the holiday season downtown.
 The announcement will include representatives from the Mayor’s Office of Special Events, H-E-B Houston, Reliant and NRG Retail, Rodeo Houston, BP and Downtown Houston+.
 The news conference will take place in the Legacy Room at Houston City Hall, located at 901 Bagby St.
 Additional details about this year’s holiday events are expected to be announced during the event.
